gate: Formal G1 is blocked until a passed matching G0 report exists. A completed diagnostic run is not a scientific go decision.

D1_condition_changes.missing: Registration of up to ten observations supporting two legitimate task instructions, condition-specific full teachers, and eight fixed full-deletion candidates per condition. If no valid pairs exist, explicitly record that D1 is not applicable.
D1_condition_changes.language_vs_proprio_note: Current G1 uses the real original instruction and normalized proprio unchanged. Selector language/proprio ablations belong to post-training A1; this code does not implement or claim them. Arbitrary mismatched instructions or proprio are not valid substitute evidence.

D2_set_changes.coverage: Frozen 90 train observations; full512 and anchored random/uniform256/128; same eight candidates per camera. Signed actual deletion labels, raw retained indices, full/partial candidate comparisons, Spearman and sign changes outside a declared tolerance are stored.
D2_set_changes.not_claimed: Sixteen anchors do not establish the full512 ranking; anchor-conditioned sets are not an unbiased deployment distribution.

D3_intervention_changes.coverage: Same S/candidate, candidate-only replacement by fixed FP32 full-camera mean cast to feature dtype, inside the actual packed S. Other features/positions/masks unchanged. Signed labels and deletion/replacement candidate ranking comparisons stored.
D3_intervention_changes.not_claimed: Not historical full-length complement replacement; not a trained 2x2 ablation.

D4_stage_and_action_dimension.available: Every observation retains task, early/middle/late and final-frame flag. Raw action errors include position/rotation/gripper, all seven dimensions and all eight chunk steps. Exact-teacher comparison summary has task, temporal-stage and final/nonfinal groups.
D4_stage_and_action_dimension.missing: Paper-ready plots; complete D2/D3 label/disagreement aggregates by task, temporal stage and final/nonfinal frame; paired cross-method differences and uncertainty analysis. Temporal thirds are not semantic manipulation phases.

exact_teacher_12.coverage: Exhaustive candidates512+256+128 under fixed staged per-camera budgets; static fullLOO, spatial uniform and three seeded random controls at256/128/64; shared action cache; exact batch1 query/length/failure/interruption ledger.
exact_teacher_12.missing_optional: ACL comparison and pre-registered smaller-step follow-up search are not implemented.
exact_teacher_12.not_claimed: The staged teacher is not a global optimal oracle or deployment baseline.

repeatability.coverage: Ten fixed observations, one per task with temporal stages cycling; two extra real calls per observation repeat the full reference and one full-deletion intervention. Resume-safe repeat IDs force the intended fresh calls exactly once.
repeatability.remaining: After actual execution, inspect numerical differences before interpreting near-zero label signs.

go_no_go.remaining: Review numerical/packing correctness, completed D1 applicability, D4 stage/frame analysis and teacher-vs-static/uniform packedE at main128 across tasks/stages. Root must issue a separate reviewed G1 passed/go report before G2 generation; CLI status completed alone is insufficient.

scientific_status: D2/D3 plus teacher12 implementation is a subset of the full G1 plan, not completed G1 experiments or evidence of method benefit.
